title: I made a infinite runner game with GPT-6 Astra without writing any of the code myself
author: _DarkAngle_
selftext:
I made a 3D game with GPT-6 Astra without writing any code myself.

I have 15+ years of software engineering experience, but never worked with Unity, 3D modeling or game development before.

I wanted to see how far I can get if I basically act as a director and let Astra do the implementation.

So I made a Subway Surfers-style infinite runner set in a 90s post-Soviet neighborhood, similar to where I grew up.

You run on cracked asphalt between apartment blocks. Footballs fly out of the windows. There are burning tires, exploding manholes and a helicopter dropping bombs. You can also pick up a Lada and get 7 seconds of invincibility.

I didn’t write any of the code myself.

Most of the process was me giving Astra references, asking it to do things in Blender and Unity, then playing the game and telling it what looks wrong.

This led to some very specific conversations about balconies, potholes, rusty Ladas and why a football was flying out of a window too fast.

It’s still work in progress. Character animation is a bit janky and the jump is especially bad. But I didn’t expect to get this far with tools I had never used before.

I'll be glad to answer any questions !

Demo video below and you can play it here: [sovietrunners.fun](http://sovietrunners.fun)
